# Extras

GitHub alerts, centered HTML, details and keyboard keys.

> [!NOTE]
> Useful information that users should know, even when skimming.

> [!TIP]
> Helpful advice for doing things better or more easily.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Key information users need to know to achieve their goal.

> [!WARNING]
> Urgent info that needs immediate user attention to avoid problems.

> [!CAUTION]
> Advises about risks or negative outcomes of certain actions.

> [!note]
> Lower-case markers work too, and the body may have several lines that
> wrap at the quote width like any other block quote.
>
> - with a list
> - inside it

<div align="center">
  <b>Centered title</b><br>
  A second centered line
</div>

<details>
<summary>Click to expand</summary>

Hidden content that mdview shows expanded, with `code` in it.

</details>

Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd> to copy and <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>V</kbd> to paste.

A paragraph with an inline ![badge](images/sample.png) placeholder that should move as a whole to the next line when it does not fit at the end.

<p align="center">
  <img src="images/sample.png" alt="centered image" width="200">
</p>

<a name="anchor-only"></a>

<h2 align="center">HTML heading</h2>

Text after an HTML heading.
